name: Composer: microphone off
what: With the microphone refused, the composer says "Microphone access is off." with Open Settings beside the crossed-out mic (was a crossed-out mic with no word).
steps: Android Settings > Apps > Off Grid AI > Permissions > Microphone > Don't allow.
Open any chat and look above the composer.

name: Composer: camera off
what: Take photo with the camera refused says "Camera access is off." with Open Settings above the composer (was nothing).
steps: Refuse Camera for Off Grid AI in Android Settings.
In a chat with a vision model: Attach > Take photo.

name: Sync: not on Wi-Fi
what: Off Wi-Fi, the Sync devices card says "This phone is not on Wi-Fi." with Try again (was a bare Offline).
steps: Turn Wi-Fi off (mobile data on); Pro on.

name: Screenshot sharing: photo access off
what: Screenshot sharing turned on with photo access refused shows "Photo access is off." with Open Settings on its row.
steps: Refuse Photos and videos for Off Grid AI in Android Settings.
Settings > Sync > Automatic sharing > Screenshots: choose Ask or Auto.
